# Overview

## Admissions Workflow

- Student submits application
- University verifies documents
- Committee reviews application
- Final decision is sent to student

## Admission Flow Diagram

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A[Student applies] --> B[University verifies documents]
    B --> C{Complete?}
    C -->|No| D[Request missing documents]
    D --> B
    C -->|Yes| E[Review application]
    E --> F{Decision}
    F -->|Accepted| G[Offer letter]
    F -->|Rejected| H[Rejection notice]
```

## Admissions Timeline

```{mermaid}
gantt
    title Admissions Timeline
    dateFormat  YYYY-MM-DD
    axisFormat  %d %b
    section Application
    Submit form       :a1, 2026-07-01, 7d
    Document review   :a2, after a1, 10d
    section Decision
    Committee review  :b1, after a2, 14d
    Decision made     :b2, after b1, 3d
```

# Summary

## Key Points

- Use `format: pptx` in YAML
- Use `##` for individual slides
- Mermaid diagrams can be included directly
- Render with:

```bash
quarto render q1_ppt.qmd --to pptx
```
